name: Summer Jewsbury
title: Respiratory Therapist
bio: I am a Registered Respiratory Therapist with 15 years of experience providing compassionate, high-quality patient care. I spent 10 years at Swedish Medical Center before joining St. Anthony North, where I've worked for the past 5 years. I'm excited to begin this new chapter as part of the team at CCPSA and look forward to contributing my experience while continuing to grow professionally. Outside of work, I've been happily married for 21 years and enjoy spending time with my husband and our dog, Floki.
